description: Foundation layer: install missing npm packages, update next.config.js security headers, create all documentation files, build the Prisma seed file, create shared UI components, create middleware for route protection, and create AuthContext + useAuth hook. These are all prerequisites with zero dependencies on each other within this FEAT — do them in one commit.
steps: Step 1 — Install dependencies: in d:\new tution website, run `npm install react-hook-form @hookform/resolvers recharts`. These are the only missing runtime deps referenced in the task.

Step 2 — Update d:\new tution website\next.config.js: add security headers (X-Frame-Options: DENY, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin, Permissions-Policy, Content-Security-Policy as a report-only header for now). Keep existing images.remotePatterns and experimental.serverActions config. Example pattern: use the `headers()` async function returning an array of { source, headers } objects.

Step 3 — Create all 10 documentation files with real content (not placeholder 'TBD' stubs). Files and required content: (a) d:
ew tution website\README.md — project overview, stack, setup instructions (npm install, copy .env.example to .env.local, npx prisma db push, npm run db:seed, npm run dev), features summary. (b) d:
ew tution website\docs\ARCHITECTURE.md — Next.js App Router structure, Prisma/PostgreSQL data layer, auth flow (httpOnly JWT cookie), role hierarchy, directory layout. (c) d:
ew tution website\docs\FEATURE_STATUS.md — table of all features with status: Implemented/In Progress/Not Started. (d) d:
ew tution website\docs\ROUTE_INVENTORY.md — full list of all app routes (pages + API), HTTP methods, auth requirements. (e) d:
ew tution website\docs\DATABASE_DESIGN.md — Prisma schema summary, entity relationships, key indexes, enum values. (f) d:
ew tution website\docs\SECURITY.md — auth mechanism, password hashing (bcrypt rounds=12), JWT expiry, httpOnly cookie, RBAC, CSP headers, no-secret-in-response rule. (g) d:
ew tution website\docs\DEPLOYMENT.md — environment variables checklist, database setup steps, build steps, health check endpoint. (h) d:
ew tution website\docs\ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLES.md — every variable with type, required/optional flag, example value (mirror .env.example and extend it). (i) d:
ew tution website\docs\CONTENT_LICENSING.md — original content policy, no-copy rule, exam information sourcing from official sites, attribution requirements. (j) d:
ew tution website\docs\TEST_PLAN.md — manual test checklist covering registration, login, enquiry form, protected routes, admin access control, empty states when DB is unavailable.

Step 4 — Create d:\new tution website\prisma\seed.ts with: 5 Board records (CBSE/cbse, ICSE/icse, ISC/isc, TN State Board/tn-state-board, TN Matriculation/tn-matriculation), 12 Class records (number 1–12, name 'Class 1'–'Class 12'), 15+ Subject records (Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, English, Tamil, Social Science, History, Geography, Computer Science, Accountancy, Economics, Business Studies, Environmental Science, Physical Education — each with unique slug), BoardClass join records linking all boards to their applicable classes, 3 demo Users: student@demo.com / teacher@demo.com / admin@demo.com all with password Demo@1234 (hashed with bcrypt), roles STUDENT/TEACHER/SUPER_ADMIN, status ACTIVE, emailVerified true. Teacher user gets a TeacherProfile. Student user gets a StudentProfile. Also create StudentProfile with boardId=CBSE, classId=Class 10. Create 4+ Course records (status PUBLISHED, isFeatured true, creatorId=admin user id) covering CBSE Class 10 Maths, TN Board Class 12 Physics, NEET Biology, JEE Chemistry. Create 5+ ExamCatalogue records (JEE Main, JEE Advanced, NEET UG, BITSAT, CUET UG) with slug, category, conductingAuth, officialWebsite, description. Create 3 Enquiry records (status NEW) as sample data. Create 2 Question records (SINGLE_MCQ, isPublished true, authorId=admin). Use upsert where possible to make seed idempotent. Export nothing — the file is run directly via tsx.

Step 5 — Create src/components/ui/ shared components. Each is a small, focused component: (a) d:
ew tution website\src\components\ui\LoadingSpinner.tsx — div with animate-spin border, accepts size prop ('sm'|'md'|'lg'). (b) d:
ew tution website\src\components\ui\ErrorMessage.tsx — styled error box using danger-50/danger-600 colors, accepts message:string. (c) d:
ew tution website\src\components\ui\EmptyState.tsx — centered box with icon slot, title, description, optional action button. Props: icon (LucideIcon), title, description, actionLabel?, actionHref?. (d) d:
ew tution website\src\components\ui\Pagination.tsx — 'use client', accepts page, totalPages, onChange callback, renders prev/next + page numbers. (e) d:
ew tution website\src\components\ui\Modal.tsx — 'use client', fixed overlay with close button, accepts isOpen, onClose, title, children. Accessible: focus trap, aria-modal, aria-labelledby. (f) d:
ew tution website\src\components\ui\Toast.tsx — 'use client', fixed bottom-right toast, accepts message, type ('success'|'error'|'info'), auto-dismisses after 4s. (g) d:
ew tution website\src\components\ui\Badge.tsx — inline span with variant prop ('primary'|'success'|'warning'|'danger'|'default'), maps to existing badge-* CSS classes. (h) d:
ew tution website\src\components\ui\Table.tsx — responsive table wrapper with thead/tbody, accepts columns:{key,label,render?} and rows:T[]. (i) d:
ew tution website\src\components\ui\StatsCard.tsx — accepts icon, label, value, trend? (number), color class prop; renders the card pattern from student dashboard. (j) d:
ew tution website\src\components\ui\SkeletonCard.tsx — animated shimmer skeleton for cards, accepts count prop.

Step 6 — Create d:\new tution website\src\components\dashboard\Sidebar.tsx — 'use client', reusable sidebar for all portals. Props: navItems:{icon, label, href}[], currentPath:string, portalName:string. Uses Link from next/link, highlights active item. No portal-specific logic.

Step 7 — Create d:\new tution website\src\components\forms\EnquiryForm.tsx — 'use client', self-contained enquiry form (extracts the form from contact/page.tsx into a reusable component). Props: onSuccess?(referenceNo:string). Uses fetch to /api/enquiries. Matches the existing form in contact/page.tsx exactly.

Step 8 — Create src/components/courses/CourseCard.tsx — accepts course object (title, slug, board, subject, lessons, duration, isFree, color) and renders the card pattern from CoursesSection.tsx. Used by courses listing pages. (b) Create d:\new tution website\src\components\courses\CourseFilters.tsx — 'use client', filter bar with board, class, subject selects + search input. Props: filters state + onChange callback.

Step 9 — Create d:\new tution website\src\context\AuthContext.tsx — 'use client', React context wrapping AuthProvider. Fetches /api/auth/me on mount, exposes user, loading, logout function. Login/register pages redirect after success using router.push, not context mutation. (b) Create d:\new tution website\src\hooks\useAuth.ts — thin hook that calls useContext(AuthContext) and throws if used outside provider.

Step 10 — Create d:\new tution website\src\middleware.ts — Next.js middleware for route protection. Protected prefixes: /student, /teacher, /parent, /admin. Check for auth_token cookie existence (not full JWT verification — full check is in server components via getCurrentUser()). If missing, redirect to /login?next=<path>. Admin routes additionally require role in ['SUPER_ADMIN','ACADEMIC_ADMIN','FINANCE_ADMIN'] — since middleware can't call Prisma, decode the JWT payload with a lightweight check on the role field using jose or by base64-decoding the payload. Decision: use jose (already compatible with Next.js edge runtime) — add `npm install jose` in this step. Or, simpler: only check cookie presence in middleware (redirect to /login), and do full role check with getCurrentUser() in the server component/layout itself. Choose the simpler approach: middleware only checks cookie existence for /student|/teacher|/parent|/admin; role checks happen in the layout server components.
acceptance_criteria: npm install completes: react-hook-form, @hookform/resolvers, recharts, jose are in package.json dependencies
next.config.js returns security headers (X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy) for all routes
All 10 docs/ files exist with real content (not empty or placeholder-only)
prisma/seed.ts exists and can be parsed by TypeScript without errors (npx tsc --noEmit passes)
All src/components/ui/*.tsx files exist and export default components
src/components/dashboard/Sidebar.tsx, src/components/forms/EnquiryForm.tsx, src/components/courses/CourseCard.tsx, src/components/courses/CourseFilters.tsx all exist
verification: cd 'd:\new tution website' && npm run lint
cd 'd:\new tution website' && npm run build
findings: All acceptance criteria met. Key notes for later FEATs: (1) react-hook-form, @hookform/resolvers, recharts, jose are now in package.json. (2) AuthContext exports AuthUser interface and AuthProvider — import AuthProvider in src/app/layout.tsx to wrap the app before using useAuth in any portal page. (3) src/middleware.ts uses cookie-presence-only check; role checks must be done in layout server components via getCurrentUser(). (4) prisma/seed.ts is idempotent (upsert-based) — safe to re-run. Demo credentials: student@demo.com/Demo@1234, teacher@demo.com/Demo@1234, admin@demo.com/Demo@1234. (5) ESLint config created at .eslintrc.json (next/core-web-vitals). (6) auth.ts JWT fix: JWT_EXPIRY cast to SignOptions['expiresIn'] — existing login/register flows unaffected. (7) jee/page.tsx and student/dashboard/page.tsx had missing lucide-react imports — fixed. (8) Navbar.tsx children type fixed by adding icon:undefined to items without icons.
